description: 臺中市回收廢棄物回收處理業者名單 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府環境保護局. 臺中市已登記應回收廢棄物回收業、處理業者名單資訊，供民眾查詢相關業者的資訊。 這些業者提供各種回收服務，包括廢汽機撤、廢鐵容器、廢鋁容器、廢玻璃容器、廢紙容器、廢塑膠容器、廢乾電池、廢鉛蓄電池、廢輪胎、廢電子電器、廢資訊物品、廢照明光源等物品的回收處理。 由此資料集，民眾可找到附近的回收業者，減少垃圾的產生，也促進企業永續環境保護。. Coverage: 臺中市政府環境保護局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府環境保護局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
